propositions: The compiled state must maintain a plan_review_phase field (planning|execution) updated only by winning process_status transitions: in_progress sets execution, open sets planning, other targets preserve current; losing fork events and snapshots never update it.

Pre-feature snapshots without plan_review_phase must bootstrap planning for open/idea status, execution for all other known statuses exactly once per reducer cache version bump, emitting structured INFO without appending ticket events.

Manifest must emit review-phase (planning|execution) and for execution only priority-floor (0.80) after advisory in fixed order, with ManifestFormatError for duplicates, missing tokens, unknown phase, non-numeric/non-finite/out-of-range floor, or execution without exactly one floor.

Plan-review validity must compute phase_status (compatible|incompatible|malformed) comparing current vs signed phase: planning state accepts planning/legacy/execution; execution state accepts planning/legacy/execution floor ≥0.80 and rejects <0.80 as incompatible; any malformed phase/floor is malformed.

Pass-3 execution-review mode must floor only the blocking_enabled float threshold to max(block_threshold, 0.80) via explicit execution_review parameter to pass3_over_findings, leaving advisory/novelty/completion/failure behavior unchanged.

Re-sign must parse exact v2 JSON phase/floor through sidecar.parse_review_phase_metadata, use recorded values, refuse incompatible/malformed variants, and collect generation once pre-sign with stable retry up to three times only for dirty HEAD, returning terminal unsigned stale on material/relation/phase change.
